completion.releaseNote: The board can approve a file and take the approval away, and offers names after @ in comments.
completion.summary: Board Memory page approves a file as it is now and removes the approval (POST /api/cards/approve, same approveCard and hash as the CLI; RepoPath keeps the read in the project folder). Comment box offers names after @ (listbox, arrow keys, Enter/Tab, Escape closes names only). Tests: ui-server route test, UI unit tests (picked handle reaches the person's My work), two Playwright flows. Commit c46791d. Not done: board does not show that an approved file changed since (kept in docs/ideas.md).

title: Board: approve a file from its card, and @name suggestions in comments
